director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj dekhenge ki ek hi bhinn ko alag numbers se kaise likhte hain, aur sabse chhote numbers mein kaise. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi

Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon. Kitchen mein mummy roti ke hisse kabhi chhote kaatti hain, kabhi mila deti hain. Roti utni hi rehti hai. Upar 1/3 rangeen hai. Neeche har hissa 2 mein kata: 6 mein se 2, yaani 2/6. Rang utna hi hai, toh yeh barabar bhinn hain. Ab socho, is 3/4 wali patti ke har hisse ko 3 barabar hisson mein kaata. Ab kitne mein se kitne hisse rangeen hain?

director.card: Ab socho, is 3/4 wali patti ke har hisse ko 3 barabar hisson mein kaata. Ab kitne mein se kitne hisse rangeen hain?

Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, har rangeen hissa bhi 3 mein kata. Ulta bhi hota hai. Upar 6 mein se 4 hisse rangeen hain. Do-do hisse milao, toh 3 bade hisse bante hain aur 2 rangeen: 4/6 = 2/3. Ab ek patti ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 8 rangeen hain. Do-do hisse mila kar bade hisse banaye: naya bhinn kya hai?

director.card: Ab ek patti ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 8 rangeen hain. Do-do hisse mila kar bade hisse banaye: naya bhinn kya hai?

Reena ne ek roti ka 2/3 khaaya, Mohit ne waisi hi roti ka 8/12. Kisne zyada khaaya, ya dono ne barabar?
director.card: Reena ne ek roti ka 2/3 khaaya, Mohit ne waisi hi roti ka 8/12. Kisne zyada khaaya, ya dono ne barabar?

Hisse mila kar dekhenge, rang utna hi hai ya nahi. Dono pattiyon ko kitne bade hisson mein milaoge, ki rangeen bhi poore milein?

Yahan pehli patti hai, 8 barabar hisson mein, aur 6 rangeen. 8 hisse bhi aur 12 hisse bhi, kitne bade hisson mein barabar mil sakte hain, ki rangeen hisse bhi poore milein?

Pehle 3/4 ke har hisse ko 3 mein kaata tha: neeche 4 × 3 = 12, upar 3 × 3 = 9. Upar aur neeche ko ek hi number se guna kiya, toh bhinn utna hi raha. Ab 3/4 ke barabar aisa bhinn chahiye jiska neeche 20 ho. Upar kaunsa number aayega?

Haan, sahi hai: neeche 4 × 5 = 20, toh upar bhi 3 × 5 = 15: 15/20. Hisse milana matlab bhaag. 10/15 ke upar aur neeche, dono ko 5 se bhaag do: 10 ÷ 5 = 2, 15 ÷ 5 = 3, toh 2/3. Yeh hisson ko paanch-paanch milana hi hai. 14/35 ke barabar woh bhinn batao jiska neeche 5 ho.
